verdict.rationale: Netlify's own marketing explicitly claims team-level management of access, secrets, and environment variables, which matches every element of the story. The claim rests on a single tagline with no detailed documentation behind it. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on role/permission models, secret scoping and masking, central env-var inheritance across projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Manage access, secrets, and env vars by team
